propositions: Add `rebar review-plan --retry` CLI flag that resumes only the latest eligible INDETERMINATE review by reusing checkpointed findings for success/resumed units and re-attempting failed/cancelled units plus budget-shed units with a fresh per-invocation attempt budget.

Retry eligibility requires the latest REVIEW_RESULT sidecar to contain a versioned discovery_journal with content-identical lineage digest across ticket material, code/ref, effective policy, prompts/contracts, model/mode, topology, context, dependencies, and source; stale, corrupt, legacy, or digest-mismatched journals are refused before any model call with exit code 2.

Reusable unit findings are reconstructed via CheckpointEnvelope from sizing.load_checkpoint() using recomputed checkpoint_identity; units whose digest matches no stored envelope or whose envelope is absent are treated as missing and re-run.

Budget-shed criteria recorded in budget_indeterminate findings are re-enumerated and re-attempted as missing units under fresh budget; cumulative lineage spend is recorded as audit telemetry but never enforced as a cap.

Pass-2 verification, coaching, deterministic decision, assembly, and signature eligibility rerun over the combined prior and newly recovered findings; retry output exposes only established end-result fields without per-unit trace details.

--retry is mutually exclusive with --force, --status, and --check, remains compatible with --no-sign, and is documented in review-plan --help, CLI reference, user guide, plan-review gate guide, and exit-codes.md.
